messages.subject: Northwind Labs interview: Senior Software Engineer, Payments
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

We'd like to invite you to interview for the Senior Software Engineer, Payments role at Northwind Labs on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT via Zoom: a 60-minute coding interview.

Job description: https://northwindlabs.com/jobs/senior-software-engineer-payments

Kai Morgan, Northwind Labs
